proof_summary: For \(n=550172\), periodicity of \(2^k\) modulo \(n\) with period \(29400\), followed by a finite modular check of the reduced exponent classes, shows that the residue \(63945\) is not attained before \(k=17135927\), so \(a(n)\ge17135927\). A bit-sieve shows that more than \(550171\) primes lie below \(8567965\), hence \(p_{550172}<8567965\) and \(2(p_{550172}-1)\le17135926\), contradicting the proposed bound.
